messages:
alex: Heads-up — cutoff for v1.8.3 is in ~2h. Please add changelog one-liners to your PRs now. Changelog lint will start blocking merges at cutoff.

maria: Quick Q — what's the exact one-liner shape we want? bullet or sentence?

alex: One line, present-tense verb, primary component tag in brackets optional, PR number. Short. Example: `storage: reduce memory used during KV cache warmup (PR #1234)` — not a paragraph.

jamal: Can release-bot auto-apply a template when the changelog label is missing? I can wire an action to create a draft entry on the PR.

release-bot: release-bot: Scheduled changelog-lint run in 2 hours. PRs merged after cutoff will require manual backport.

deploy-bot: FYI the merge-queue will lock `release/v1.8` at cutoff + 5m. Any hotfixes must be labelled `hotfix` and approved by Eng Leads.

sara: Small reminder — use `semver:patch` for docs/typo fixes. The bump action uses labels: `semver:patch`, `semver:minor`, `semver:major`. Avoid minor bumps for content-only changes. :mag:

maria: Cool, thanks. Do we need author/timestamp in the one-liner?

alex: No, CI will inject author + PR link into the rolled-up changelog during the release job. Just the concise description + PR ref is enough.

jamal: Example entry I'm about to add: 
```
- storage: reduce memory used during KV cache warmup (PR #1234) — cuts peak GPU mem on cold-start by ~12%
```

alex: Nice. If your change touches multiple components, put the primary tag first and comma-separate the rest: `compute: improve batching, storage: minor KV cache fix (PR #5678)`.

devops: Quick ops note — branch `release/v1.8` is locked after cutoff. If you need a backport, add `backport:requested` label plus the target branch in the PR description. We’ll triage.

maria: Adding entries now. If the lint still fails, who should I ping?

alex: Ping me or @jamal, but first check the lint output in the checks tab — it usually tells you the shape issue. Common failures: missing PR number, too long, or using past tense.

sara: Also, can we confirm the parser accepts em dashes? It failed once copying a sentence with an — and it errored.

alex: Good catch. I’ll run a quick parse test and push a tiny tolerant change to the parser before cutoff. If anything breaks, I'll post here.

jamal: I'll open a tiny PR to add an autofill action: if PR label `changelog-missing` is set, create a draft changelog entry with a suggested one-liner (author can edit). Saves some back-and-forth.

release-bot: release-bot: Autofill action will require `pull_request` write perms. Requesting approval from repo owners.

maria: Sweet. That should help us meet the cutoff without mass manual edits. Thanks team :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks everyone — please double-check your PRs in the next 90 minutes. I'll report back if I push the parser tweak.

devops: Reminder: if you must merge after cutoff, add `emergency: true` and tag an Eng Lead. Those merges go through a manual gate.

jamal: Adding the action PR now -> will link it here when ready.

sara: Copy — will not bump minor for a doc-only PR.

alex: Closing loop: parser tweak pushed (build green). If lint still errors for someone, paste the raw error here and we'll sort it quickly.
